mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) over the next 20 trading days signals an easing monetary policy cycle, compressing discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS does not decline over the 20-day horizon, or 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in the federal funds rate below 4.0% triggers a sustained easing cycle, reducing policy tightness and enhancing equity risk premium, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS remains above 4.0% during the 5-day window, or 5-day forward returns are not statistically positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate below 5.0% signals a strengthening labor market, increasing consumer demand and corporate profits, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE remains ≥5.0% during the 20-day window, or 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in unemployment (UNRATE) and rise in payroll employment (PAYEMS) signal robust labor market expansion, stimulating consumer demand and corporate investment, which amplifies S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: labor market expansion with falling unemployment and rising payroll
failure_condition: Either UNRATE does not fall below 5.0% or PAYEMS does not exceed 140,000 during the 60-day window, or returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, persistently low federal funds rates near zero signal continued accommodative monetary policy, sustaining equity valuations and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS does not remain below 0.25% during the 20-day window, or returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) in this regime.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) above 106.66 signals robust economic activity, boosting corporate earnings and investor confidence, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO does not exceed 106.66 during the 5-day window, or returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in industrial production (INDPRO) and personal consumption (GDPC1) signals robust economic growth, enhancing corporate profits and equity valuations, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Either INDPRO does not exceed 106.66 or GDPC1 does not surpass 18406.941 during the 60-day window, or returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In a post-recession labor market recovery regime, a decline in the unemployment rate below 6.0% signals labor market improvement, stimulating consumer spending and corporate profits, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE does not fall below 6.0% during the 20-day window, or returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) in this regime.
